svg.title: 330 issues closed with Prisma ORM 8
svg.desc: A centered typographic cover: the number 330 in large Sora type above the words issues closed, with a Prisma ORM 8 kicker, a line noting 8,922 upvotes and the oldest issue open since 2019, on light paper with a cyan prism wash. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand.

g.text: 8,922 upvotes on GitHub, the oldest open since 2019
